book.name: 2 Kolinita
book.title: 2 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta heluwena Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Paulo ꞌina paihowa
Cigu gwae bewa gide yauyaule yagwaegwae, ma hesi ꞌeguma waꞌalamaꞌiꞌita, ꞌigu nuwatuhu yahepwaila latuwe ꞌoimiya.
Weyahina nuwanuwagu ꞌomi, gidemusa Yehoba nuwanuwana tauda, ꞌoinega yagwae hemisaegomiya Keliso ꞌoina, ꞌomi gidemusa gumalaulau ꞌaigeda ꞌina mumuga bwebweꞌana mabwaiyana, ma loheya baꞌidana sihai.
Ma hesi yaꞌateyohowa weyahimi, ꞌamuge ma ꞌimi nuwatuhu siꞌwani ma ꞌimi ꞌatetagwala Keliso ꞌoina waꞌebesine, gide mwalo mwata Ibe ꞌiꞌaboweya ꞌina gwae hotohoto ꞌoinega, ta Ibeina ꞌiweꞌa.

Coinega ꞌeguma taiya ꞌitautauyawa ma Yesu tetelina ꞌoimiya ꞌilohatotowe ma geya tauma ꞌima lohatoto gide, tauna ꞌoina watagwa tagwalegomi. Comi wasa bwebweꞌana ꞌoina watagwala pwaiyegomiya ta Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoimiya walotohoya, ma tuwa hali tetela ma hali yaluyaluwa ꞌoidiya watagwa tagwalegomi.
Cimi tologuguyao hauhaudiyedi ꞌomi wanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega sihane sinegauwa, ma hesi geya sowasowahidi.
Ceguma geya yada gwae bwaibwaina, ma hesi yasanapu moisa ma tuta mabwaiyana ꞌigu sanapuina yaheꞌita pwaidiya ꞌoimiya.
Mwalo Yehoba wasana ꞌoimiya yalohatotoweya, ma geya ꞌeta maisa weyahina yagwaegwae ꞌoimiya, ꞌoinega wanuwatuhuya yalopuiya weyahina taugu yaꞌabi suluhegauwa ma ꞌabehega ꞌomi wahane.
Cana ꞌita gide yayagayagaha hali hekalesiyao ꞌoidiyega, weyahina mane siꞌebwaegauwa ma ꞌabehega ꞌomi weyahimi yapaihowa.

Wete tutaina ꞌimi tupwa yamiyamiya ma yagomagomale geya yada ꞌahwanoiya ꞌoimiya, ma hesi tupwana tasidao Masidoniya ꞌoinega sitauyama ta lema siꞌebwaegauwa; weyahina geya nuwagu ma mwau ꞌoimiya yalagu ꞌagu ꞌeꞌahai weyahina. Mwalo geya ꞌaigeda mwau ꞌoimiya yalagu, ma tuta sinaonaoma ꞌoidiya wete sahena yalagulagu.
Cigu gwae hane bewa gwae moisa Keliso ꞌoinega, ma sahena ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌigu gwae bewa ꞌiꞌetoꞌetobode Akaya tupwanao mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya.
Ma toꞌaha huhuna? Nuwana ꞌigu gwae bewa weyahina ta yalogwahategomiya? Sahena! Yehoba ꞌisanapu bwaibwainigauwa yahelauwegomiya.
Wete ꞌigu paihowa weyahimi tuwa ꞌabwa yada paipaihowa, ma ꞌoinega yaꞌabihe lolagudi taudi togwae gagasa sigwaeya ꞌabehega ꞌidi paihowa ꞌoimiya gide taugu ꞌigu paihowa.
Weyahina toꞌabowedi ꞌadi ꞌita gide Keliso ꞌana tohepwailao ma hesi galana sipaipaihowa.
Taudi gide Seitani, mumugana galana, ma hesi ꞌana ꞌita ꞌibuiya gide anelose ꞌasiꞌasilalana.

Coinega sahena nuwami ꞌihehenainaida ꞌeguma Seitani ꞌina topaihowao wete ꞌadi ꞌita sibuidi ma topaihowa dumwaludi gide. Ma tuwa, tuta ꞌebelosaloha ꞌoina ꞌidi mumuga galadi weyahidi taudi nata sigala hedade.
Paulo ꞌina muyamuyao
Yada hegwaegomi wete sahena waꞌahwaꞌahwa yauyaulegau, ma ꞌeguma waꞌahwa yauyaulegau tuwa, ꞌausala, ma ꞌigu gwae yauyaule wahesagohe, ma ꞌoinega tupwana yada gwae gagasa.
Cigu gwae gagasa bewa geya ꞌida Bada ꞌina loinega, ma hesi yauyaulegu tuwa.
Weyahina tomota mabwaiyadi sigwaegwae gagasa ginaula baleꞌu weyahidi, ꞌoinega taugu wete yada gwae gagasa taudi gide.
Ma ꞌomi hesi sanasanapumi ta tomota yauyauleidi ꞌoidiya waꞌatetagwala,
ꞌeguma paihowa mwaudi siꞌebwaegomi, ma ꞌoinega ꞌoimiyega siyagayagaha, ma siꞌabowegomiya, ma maꞌidi nuwahane manimiya sisapi.

Ma taugu weꞌaweꞌagu, ꞌoinega geya yada sapigomiya, ta bewa ꞌebedeba mwadina ꞌoiguwa. Ta ꞌeguma ꞌimi tologuguyaedi toꞌaha weyahidi sigwaegwae gagasa, hesi tuwa taugu yahetohe yauyaule ma yagwae gagasa ginaulaedi weyahidi.

content.text: Ceguma taudi Isileli ꞌina susuwao, taugu gide.
Ceguma taudi Ebalahamo tubunao, taugu gide.
Ceguma taudi Keliso ꞌina hewahewaliyao bwebweꞌadi, taugu ꞌina hewali bwebweꞌana hedade.

content: Cigu gwae bewa gide yauyauleigu. Cigu guibiga ꞌoinega yanugeta sinediya, ꞌigu luhu deliya baibaiwa hedade, ꞌagu sapiyao wete baibaiwana ta tuta mabwaiyana ꞌoidiyega ꞌabehega tuwa nata yaꞌamasa.
MeYudiya balaeyega sisapigauwa, ꞌana baibaiwa teti naini, ta sapiina bewa gide ma nima ꞌaiꞌaigeda yalobediya.
Matoi wete sihunugauwa ꞌaiwe ꞌoidiyega, maꞌaigeda dimwega sihunu dadanegauwa, matoi waga ꞌoinega yadamana niꞌu ꞌawawa, ma sabwelo ꞌaigeda ma nihuwana ꞌaigeda ꞌidoegauwa.

Ma wete ꞌigu ꞌadau ꞌoidiyega ꞌebehesilae yalobediya weꞌaha madoudi ma toyagahao ꞌoidiyega, ma ꞌigu bodao meYudiya ꞌoidiyega, ma taudi geya meYudiya ꞌoidiyega, ta ꞌasa madoudi ꞌoidiyega, ta pwatula ꞌoidiya, ta wete niꞌu ꞌawawa, ma wete tasidao ꞌaboꞌaboidi ꞌoidiyega,

ꞌima paihowa madouna, ma miyamwau ꞌadi tuta ꞌoidiya, nihuwana geya yada ꞌenowa, ma gomale ta taniꞌoyahala, wete tuta tupwana baibaiwana geya ꞌagumo, ta geya ꞌigu hadamo, ma geya ꞌagu ꞌwamamo tuta gogai ꞌoidiya.
Ma wete sabwelo mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya yanuwanuwatuhu madouna tohekalesiyao tupwa baibaiwadi weyahimi.
Coinega ꞌeguma taiya ꞌiweꞌa, taugu wete gide yaweꞌa, ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌebetupa ꞌoina ꞌibeꞌu, beno ꞌigu ꞌebe nuwagala.
Ma waꞌita, ꞌigu gwae gagasa ꞌigu weꞌaomo weyahidi.
Yehoba tauna ꞌida Bada Yesu tamana tada hepwatuwe hataya, ma tauna ꞌisanasanapugau ꞌabehega ꞌigu heꞌoteꞌotetela bewa gwae moisa.
Mwalo, kini Alesitasi ꞌina tuta toloina ꞌaigeda ꞌasa Damasiko ꞌoina ꞌitoho waiwai ma ꞌabehega maꞌina toloꞌalehao siꞌabiyahigau,
ma hesi ꞌiyagwao siꞌabihetegauwa, ta ꞌali ꞌana ꞌahwaꞌeda tabwaninega sisoꞌeya, ta ꞌoinega silagu suluhegauwa kodowega baleꞌuwa, ta ꞌagu ꞌalehaowedi ꞌoidiyega yadena.
